## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes
- [ ] `uv run ruff check src/` is clean
- [ ] `uv run basedpyright` is clean
- [ ] Docs updated if public-facing behavior changed (see `docs/`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] Breaking changes are called out (pre-1.0: allowed, but note them in the
      changelog under **Breaking**)
